texts.en:
An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near [physics_planet.GetName]. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dynamics.

Focused study of this quantum field would allow us to better understand the fundamental building blocks of our universe.
